description: This file is a shell script containing tests for the 'fsck' functionality in Git, specifically testing buffers without NUL termination and object parsing robustness. It defines functions to reset state, add data, and check for specific parsing failures related to corrupted or truncated Git objects.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the test environment by creating or clearing the 'base' file.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a line to the 'base' file with specified content.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a test to verify that a truncated or malformed object causes 'git hash-object' to fail as expected.
